title: nonatelia andamanica
intro: Nonatelia andamanica, commonly known as Andaman nonatelia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It is a medicinal plant found in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands in India, which has been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Nonatelia andamanica include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to exhibit cardiotonic, hypoglycemic, and hepatoprotective activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
